title: INTEGER*2 multiplication overflows silently — wrapping at 2^15
sourceContent:
SUBROUTINE COUNT_TOTAL(N, K, TOTAL)
C     Multiplies N*K into a 16-bit total. INTEGER*2 wraps at 32767
C     -- inputs of (200, 300) silently produce -5536 instead of
C     60000. The wider C/Java equivalent (int = 32 bits) does not
C     reproduce this without an explicit (short) cast.
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER*2 N, K, TOTAL
      TOTAL = N * K
      RETURN
      END
notes: INTEGER*2 is extinct in modern languages — Java/C# default to int32. A direct port silently changes behaviour for valid inputs that USED to overflow. The spec must flag the 16-bit range and surface the open question of how the rewrite should handle inputs that would overflow in the legacy world.
